name: botrelay
description: A password manager built for AI agents. Hosted MCP returns sealed secrets; botrelay-cli decrypts them on your machine. Give agents their own vault, only the secrets they need, and tools that keep the vault key local. Visit https://botrelay.ai for more information.

API_BASE_URL.title: API base URL
API_BASE_URL.description: Origin of the hosted BotRelay API. Production is https://api.botrelay.ai. For stage dogfood, select https://stage.botrelay.ai and use a stage agent API key. Hosted MCP is this origin plus /mcp/ (trailing slash). Do not include /mcp/ in this value.

BOTRELAY_API_KEY.title: Agent API key
BOTRELAY_API_KEY.description: BotRelay agent API key (brt_live_…). Sent only as Authorization: Bearer to hosted MCP at whatever API_BASE_URL is configured (default https://api.botrelay.ai, so https://api.botrelay.ai/mcp/). Use a key issued for that environment. Do not enter the vault key.
